hypothesis: Unwind each XY independently; same-slice credible continuation may cross masked gaps; stack rows without cross-Z identity requirements.

reference.direction: increasing angle; clockwise in image coordinates
reference.seed: nearest eligible positive-X ray ridge to elliptical radius40 within20..80; no prior trace

continuation.prediction: linear radial slope from last up-to7 consecutive points, clipped ±120 px/radian
continuation.repeat_stop: after300 degrees, any return within1px of geometry at least240 degrees earlier; no forced closure

sampling.method: linear XY in Euclidean chord arc; bilinear original CT, float64
sampling.gaps: chord length between endpoints is a lower-bound placeholder, ALL samples inside blank; never sample connector
sampling.terminal: one masked sample sentinel after STOP; unknown remainder length not inferred; rectangular padding remains masked

no_cross_z: Pure process_slice(image) function receives no Z, neighbor image, old trace or track.
limits: Fixed geometric reference is not a measured roll center. Angular-monotone bounded path can stop at folds; one selected candidate winding, not all sheets.
success_evaluation: 50 independently constructed rows with nonempty recovered geometry and correctly masked gaps; inspect coverage and failure modes, no cross-Z persistence gate.
